author: Viraj Patel
description: Async orchestration capability plugin for vwf — the neutral contract every durable-work backend must satisfy (at-least-once delivery and the idempotency it forces, retry and back-off discipline, the poison-message path, visibility into work in flight) plus the self-hosted engine that belongs to no cloud: **Temporal**. Managed flavours — Cloud Workflows, Pub/Sub, task queues and the rest — come from the project's own cloud plugin, not from here. Implements the vwf stack-adapter contract.
name: orchestration
